payload.title: Horizon is open to instance operators only
payload.context: Security review of M3 (#16): Horizon was open to every signed-in user and to everyone in the local environment.
payload.rationale: Queue payloads and failures can show data of every workspace, so only whoever operates the instance may see them. NOONGUN_OPERATOR_EMAILS names the operators; when empty, a self-hosted instance falls back to the owners of the oldest workspace and a SaaS instance lets nobody in.
payload.consequences: A SaaS instance must set NOONGUN_OPERATOR_EMAILS.
